about: The Channel Islands (P4-T13b): the islands of the islands layer inside OpenStreetMap's Channel Islands (osm:r6031891), and the countries Guernsey and Jersey, from the Western Europe trial's working data of 21 November 2026 (the planet file of 26 October 2026), simplified to 0.0001 degrees; and the group of islands the island-groups stage made from them, in the layer island-groups.
